newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds closed higher in line with other major bond markets, recovering well from previous days' lows, dealers said.
But the mood has changed and they ruled out the possibility of the recovery lasting through the coming week.
"I think it is really difficult to reach a level of 107.50, and even though we will get there, we will then start to fall again," said Jose Ramon Nunez at Benito y Monjardin.
He said that the market could fall to a level of 104.50/105, while others forecast the spread over the 10-year German Bund could rise to over 200 basis points in a couple of weeks.
